summary: Motorcar Parts of America Inc. filed an 8-K reporting Amendment No. 7 to the CEO's employment agreement and a salary increase. No forced or abrupt departure occurred; instead, the term was extended to July 2029 and salary raised to $902,799 (June 2026) then $984,050 (April 2027). This is a routine executive compensation adjustment, not an abrupt change. Since the filing describes a contractual amendment extending an ongoing CEO's term rather than a sudden resignation or replacement, it does not meet the forced/abrupt standard for Management Changes.
